description: Scripts and data from "Towards the Summary Depiction of Prevailing Power Flow Directionality Using A Wind Rose Representation is a model or code deposit deposited in Figshare by its authors Cian Kelly, Paul Cuffe. These are the Python scripts and datasets underpinning this paper: C. Kelly and P. Cuffe, "Towards the Summary Depiction of Prevailing Power Flow Directionality Using A Wind Rose Representation," 2024 IEEE 3rd Industrial Electronics Society Annual On-Line Conference (ONCON) , Beijing, China, 2024, pp. 1-6, doi: 10.1109/ONCON62778.2024.10931391. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 5666346 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
